markdown:
| Symptom                                                                       | Cause                                                          | Remedy                                                                                                                                          |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Horizontal (side-to-side) alignment cannot be obtained (angular or parallel). | The driver feet are bolt-bound.                                | Loosen the pump's hold-down bolts, and slide the pump and driver until you achieve horizontal alignment.                                        |
| Horizontal (side-to-side) alignment cannot be obtained (angular or parallel). | The baseplate is not leveled properly and is probably twisted. | 1. Determine which corners of the baseplate are high or low. 2. Remove or add shims at the appropriate corners. 3. Realign the pump and driver. |
